labels.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE for source-backed rabbit SC plasma group-mean concentration-time inputs only. All supplied cells and notes were reviewed. Body rows contain marker labels, times, mean concentrations, pixel coordinates and SOURCE_REVIEW flags. The observations were digitized from observed markers, with approximate concentration and pixel time; marker labels are not animal identifiers. The source limits use to an exploratory descriptive candidate pending reconciliation. Requirement links identify partial supporting inputs and explicit limitations, not complete requirement satisfaction. Total/free basis, dose substance basis, formulation, individual sampling relationships, biological variability and assay censoring definitions remain unspecified. Notes identify timing/count discrepancies, a whole-lung discrepancy outside this plasma table, and no measured rabbit fu located. No fitting, component qualification, conversion or translation acceptance is established.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T8:A71-A78 identify S22 Figure 2 panel A, digitized observed markers and group means. No individual IDs or SD were recovered; serial versus destructive sampling, point-specific counts, error-bar definitions and assay BLQ/LLOQ metadata are not established. Marker labels cannot establish individual animals, and SOURCE_REVIEW is not a censoring definition.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported sampling-unit relationships, count applicability, error-bar definitions, assay censoring/missingness metadata and the meaning of SOURCE_REVIEW. Preserve all marker labels and plotted values without inventing animal identities.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T8:A72 establishes PMB, SC dosing and plasma, but total versus unbound concentration, formulation and salt/free-base/activity dose basis are NOT_FOUND. The whole-lung and Tissue/ELF notes do not make those matrices part of the plasma observations.
findings.needed_material: Original source definitions for formulation, dose substance basis and concentration basis before comparison, conversion or physiological bridging.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T8:A77 states that plotted plasma times/count differ from the blood protocol. A78 reports Methods n=3-4/time and caption n=3/time without a recovered error-bar definition. Their applicability to individual plasma markers remains unresolved. Pixel times are approximate; the table does not establish actual individual sampling times.
findings.needed_material: Source reconciliation of Figure 2 panel A marker identity, timing and applicable counts. Retain plotted times separately from nominal blood times and retain both count statements.

findings.reason: MI004 remains AMBIGUOUS and OPEN, needed_at prepare. F0003:S3:T8:A80 identifies a reported discrepancy between SC whole-lung Fig.2 peak and Table S5 Cmax, but this plasma item supplies neither discrepant numerical value nor its units. A77-A78 additionally identify timing/count issues. These notes do not justify modifying or rescaling this plasma curve, and DR004 is only partially supported.
findings.needed_material: Both whole-lung values with units, exact source locators, study/regimen, measurement context and the applicable recorded review decision before value selection or reconciliation.

findings.reason: MI002 remains NOT_FOUND and OPEN, needed_at adequacy. The proposal-reported limit concerns additional public rabbit PMB concentration evidence. This item provides one digitized candidate curve but does not document the scope of that search or establish absence from all sources or unread attachments.
findings.needed_material: Record the reported search scope and its consequences during adequacy assessment, preserving the distinction between not found, unsearched and absent evidence.

findings.reason: MI003 remains DEFERRED and OPEN, needed_at pk. F0003:S3:T8:A79 explicitly limits the curve to an exploratory descriptive candidate pending reconciliation and excludes individual population PK or absolute SC CL without F. DR006 and DR008 have candidate systemic plasma inputs, but component identifiability and inclusion, exclusion or exploratory-use decisions are not established.
findings.needed_material: Later animal-PK assessment under SC011 using reconciled inputs, with the component-support decision and rationale recorded. Any required fitting remains downstream work.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T8:A80 states No measured rabbit fu located. No binding measurement or directly measured free-concentration definition is supplied. This is a scoped availability statement, not proof that rabbit binding evidence does not exist.
findings.needed_material: If a rabbit free-exposure endpoint or binding correction is used, obtain permitted species/matrix-specific binding evidence with its fraction definition, method, conditions and concentration range, or retain the endpoint-specific limitation.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T8:A76 supplies New Zealand White rabbit age and 3.31+/-0.31 kg, but the statistic represented by +/-0.31, individual weight relationships and health/infection state are unspecified. The item supplies one species' digitized plasma curve, not qualified parameters or established cross-species compatibility.
findings.needed_material: Confirm the study/group applicability and statistical definition of the reported weight and the animal health/infection state before using these inputs in a size-scaling assessment.

findings.reason: MI019 remains DEFERRED and OPEN, needed_at clinical. For DR039, this item supplies group means without recovered individual IDs or SD. F0003:S3:T8:A75 explicitly defines +/-2 pixels as digitization tolerance rather than a confidence interval or biological SD. Neither that tolerance nor the reported body-weight spread establishes individual PK variability.
findings.needed_material: Assess the defensible PK variability basis under SC031 and SC038 before PTA simulation. Retain unsupported variability, uncertainty distributions and dependencies as unresolved; do not construct them from group means or digitization tolerance.
